description: Search documents in AiDocX. Searches across all document types (contracts, proposals, quotations, resumes, reports, etc.). Supports text search, date filtering, and pagination. Returns matching documents sorted by relevance by default.

dateFrom.description: Filter results from this date (ISO 8601, e.g., '2024-01-01')

dateTo.description: Filter results up to this date (ISO 8601)

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination. Default: 0

query.description: Search query text (max 500 chars). Searches document names and content.

sortBy.description: Sort results by relevance, date, or name. Default: relevance

name: search_documents
